summary: Tested new modern e-commerce checkout pages for Orange Pharmacy (/pharmacy/checkout) and Mango Health Labs (/mango/checkout). All tested features working correctly including step progress indicators, cart display, OTP form, and navigation from StickyCartBar.

pharmacy_page_loads.details: Pharmacy page loads correctly with Orange Pharmacy header, product cards with ADD buttons visible

pharmacy_add_to_cart.details: Items can be added to cart, toast notification shows 'Added [item] to cart'

pharmacy_sticky_cart_bar.details: StickyCartBar appears at bottom showing '1 item in cart' and 'Checkout' button with data-testid='checkout-btn'

pharmacy_checkout_navigation.details: Clicking Checkout button navigates to /pharmacy/checkout correctly

pharmacy_checkout_step_progress.details: Step progress indicator shows Cart → Address → Payment with correct styling

pharmacy_checkout_cart_items.details: Cart items displayed with name, quantity controls (+/-), and delete button

pharmacy_checkout_form.details: User details form present with Full Name, WhatsApp Number (+91 prefix), Email fields. All fields have correct data-testid attributes

pharmacy_otp_button.details: Verify via WhatsApp OTP button present with data-testid='send-otp-btn', enabled when name and phone filled

pharmacy_continue_button.details: Continue button present at bottom, disabled until OTP verified (data-testid='proceed-to-address-btn')

mango_page_loads.details: Mango Labs page loads correctly with header, test categories (Pathology, Imaging), and search functionality

mango_add_tests_to_cart.details: Tests can be added to cart, toast notification shows 'Diabetes Screening selected! 3 tests added'

mango_checkout_step_progress.details: Step progress indicator shows Tests → Schedule → Payment with green theme (#22C55E)

mango_checkout_selected_tests.details: Selected Tests section shows test names (FBS, PPBS, HbA1c) with test icons and delete buttons

mango_checkout_patient_details.details: Patient Details form present with Full Name, WhatsApp Number, Email fields

mango_otp_verification.details: Verify via WhatsApp OTP button present with correct data-testid

mango_checkout_price_display.details: Total Amount shows 'Price on confirmation' for custom tests, 'Home collection FREE' text visible

back_navigation.details: Back button present on both checkout pages with data-testid='checkout-back-btn'

pharmacy_checkout.step_indicators: 3 steps with icons - Package, MapPin, CreditCard
pharmacy_checkout.text_contrast: Good - white header text, dark body text on light background

mango_checkout.text_contrast: Good - white header text, dark body text on light background

success_rate.frontend: 100% - All checkout page features working correctly

context_for_next_testing_agent: New modern checkout pages at /pharmacy/checkout and /mango/checkout are fully functional. Key features: Step progress indicators, Cart/test display with CartContext integration, OTP verification flow (sends to WhatsApp), Address management with localStorage persistence, Payment method selection (COD, Pay Later, Pay Now). StickyCartBar component shows on Pharmacy page (step=1) and Mango page (step=0) and navigates to new checkout pages. All data-testid attributes properly implemented for testing.
